note: Forbidden: sending the 16-octet Link-Local-only field for IPv4 NLRI when capability 77 plus RFC 8950 were not both negotiated. TestIPv4NLRINextHopIsThirtyTwoOctetsWithoutTheCombination asserts require.ErrorIs(err, ErrNextHopLinkLocalOnly) from resolveNextHop and assert.Len(field, 32) with Global then Link-Local; admitting the 16-octet form turns it red. The negative TestIPv4NLRILinkLocalOnlyNextHopNeedsTheCombination shows the 16-octet form is sent once both are negotiated.
